name: Store Fulfillment & Execution core scenarios
description: Real Store Fulfillment & Execution Q&A pairs grounded in BOPIS orders, fulfillment SLAs, pick accuracy, and industry benchmarks: BOPIS SLA compliance % by store, curbside pickup wait time trends, pick accuracy % by department, and omnichannel fulfillment benchmarks.

parts.text: What is our BOPIS SLA compliance percentage across stores for the past two weeks?

Over the past two weeks, overall BOPIS SLA compliance averaged 88.5% across stores. Downtown Flagship (STORE-001) achieved the highest compliance at 92.4%, while City Galleria (STORE-004) had the lowest at 84.1%, based on internal fulfillment SLA data.
What are the average curbside pickup wait time trends across stores over the last two weeks?

Curbside pickup wait times averaged 5.4 minutes across all stores. Wait times peaked during weekend afternoon hours at Suburban Plaza (STORE-002) averaging 7.8 minutes, based on internal curbside tracking data.
Which department has the lowest pick accuracy percentage across our stores?
Apparel recorded the lowest pick accuracy at 94.2% due to mispicks in sizing, whereas Grocery achieved the highest accuracy at 98.1%, based on internal department pick accuracy summary data.
How do our BOPIS order fulfillment times and curbside wait times compare to retail industry omnichannel benchmarks?

Our average BOPIS pick time of 21.5 minutes and curbside wait time of 5.4 minutes compare favorably with retail industry benchmarks (2-hour pick window, 6-8 minute curbside wait), based on internal SLA metrics and external industry market research.
